Hand-write one only for a set assemble.py does not build, in exactly this shape; never a start_image or end_image role.
Described in: Flow v3.3 - 6 Scene prompts (steps 11 and 13: the reference list, numbered per kind in media order) and Flow v3.3 - 7 Takes (the media sent with the generation).

A character with a video element has only its VIDEO entry, never its sheet beside it; an IMAGE is for what has no element (the extras' group picture cropped to this scene, a prop), or one of the exceptions of Flow v3.3 - 6 Scene prompts, step 11 (a faceless sheet variant tagged <NAME> SHEET, a second look's sheet, the picture of a character beyond the three with a video element). At most three VIDEO entries (check.py STOP 4).
